description: This file defines the Cobalt extension configuration API, including function pointers for various configuration options related to rendering, caching, and system behavior, intended for use in the Cobalt project.

methods.name: CobaltUserOnExitStrategy
methods.description: Function pointer returning a string that specifies the exit strategy for Cobalt.

methods.name: CobaltRenderDirtyRegionOnly
methods.description: Function pointer returning a bool indicating support for rendering only modified regions.

methods.name: CobaltEglSwapInterval
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int for eglSwapInterval value.

methods.name: CobaltFallbackSplashScreenUrl
methods.description: Function pointer returning a string URL for the default splash screen.

methods.name: CobaltEnableQuic
methods.description: Function pointer returning a bool to enable Quic support.

methods.name: CobaltSkiaCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int for Skia cache size in bytes.

methods.name: CobaltOffscreenTargetCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int for offscreen target cache size.

methods.name: CobaltEncodedImageCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int for encoded image cache size.

methods.name: CobaltImageCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int for image cache size.

methods.name: CobaltLocalTypefaceCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int for local typeface cache size.

methods.name: CobaltRemoteTypefaceCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int for remote typeface cache size.

methods.name: CobaltMeshCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int for mesh cache size.

methods.name: CobaltSoftwareSurfaceCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int for software surface cache size.

methods.name: CobaltImageCacheCapacityMultiplierWhenPlayingVideo
methods.description: Function pointer returning a float to adjust image cache during video playback.

methods.name: CobaltSkiaGlyphAtlasWidth
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int for glyph atlas width.

methods.name: CobaltSkiaGlyphAtlasHeight
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int for glyph atlas height.

methods.name: CobaltJsGarbageCollectionThresholdInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int for JS GC threshold.

methods.name: CobaltReduceCpuMemoryBy
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int to reduce CPU memory usage.

methods.name: CobaltReduceGpuMemoryBy
methods.description: Function pointer returning an int to reduce GPU memory usage.

methods.name: CobaltGcZeal
methods.description: Function pointer returning a bool to enable zealous garbage collection.

methods.name: CobaltRasterizerType
methods.description: Function pointer returning a string indicating the rasterizer type.

methods.name: CobaltEnableJit
methods.description: Function pointer returning a bool to enable JIT compilation.

methods.name: CobaltFallbackSplashScreenTopics
methods.description: Function pointer returning a string mapping splash screen topics to URLs.

methods.name: CobaltCanStoreCompiledJavascript
methods.description: Function pointer returning a bool indicating if compiled JS caching is enabled.
